title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Deposit Cards and Card Deposit Figures
content:
For each Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class, the payments schedule sets the card types accepted for the deposit hold, the class's card deposit figure for a credit card and for a debit card (the class's authorization-hold figure for that card type), and the number of calendar days after the contract closes by which an uncaptured hold is released. On every class the deposit card must be in the renter's name.

| Vehicle class | Card types accepted for the deposit | Card deposit, credit card (USD) | Card deposit, debit card (USD) | Uncaptured hold released within (calendar days after closing) | Deposit card in the renter's name |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | Credit card, debit card | 100.00 | 200.00 | 7 | Required |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | Credit card, debit card | 100.00 | 200.00 | 7 | Required |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | Credit card, debit card | 150.00 | 250.00 | 7 | Required |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | Credit card, debit card | 150.00 | 250.00 | 7 | Required |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | Credit card only | 200.00 | 300.00 | 7 | Required |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | Credit card only | 250.00 | 350.00 | 7 | Required |

## Points of reading

- The Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck and the Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck accept a credit card only for the deposit; their debit card figures (300.00 and 350.00) stand on the schedule, but a debit card is not among the card types those classes accept.
- On every class the debit card figure is 100.00 above the credit card figure.
- The release period is 7 calendar days after the contract closes, on every class.
